# Paulo Chang

> Senior backend engineer in Berlin with more than ten years of backend work for large brands, mostly on Adobe Experience Manager, Java and serverless. Backend Community AI Champion at Cognizant Netcentric, where Paulo built and maintains an internal AI tooling marketplace for backend developers and runs the training that goes with it. Looking for a leadership role focused on AI adoption in software development.

This is a personal professional profile plus a few side projects. Every page has a Markdown version, declared in the HTML with `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">` and linked below. The Markdown files are served as `text/markdown` and are the best source for agents: they have the same text as the pages without the layout markup. Most project pages run in the browser, so their Markdown describes the tool instead of copying its text.

Canonical host: https://paulochang.com/

## Profile

- [Home](https://paulochang.com/index.md): name, role, and links.
- [About](https://paulochang.com/about/index.md): background and current focus areas.
- [Resume](https://paulochang.com/resume/index.md): complete role history (Cognizant Netcentric, Hyggs, earlier AEM platform work), skills and stack, certifications, and spoken languages.

## Projects

- [Projects index](https://paulochang.com/projects/index.md): listing page linking to the tools below.
- [BSR Straßenreinigung Berlin](https://paulochang.com/berlin-cleaning/index.md): MapLibre GL map of Berlin's official street-cleaning classes (Reinigungsklassen), in German and English, with address search and a filter for each class. Live page: https://paulochang.com/berlin-cleaning/
- [A Moment of Light](https://paulochang.com/quotes/index.md): Shows one short poem at a time, picked at random from a small collection. Live page: https://paulochang.com/quotes/
- [Syntax-Aware Diff Tool](https://paulochang.com/diff/index.md): Diff tool built on the Monaco diff editor, with side-by-side and inline views, drag-and-drop files and a count of added, removed and changed lines. Live page: https://paulochang.com/diff/
- [JSON Query Tool (JSONata)](https://paulochang.com/json/index.md): Paste JSON, browse it as a tree and query it with JSONata, with autocomplete and results that update as you type. Live page: https://paulochang.com/json/
- [Geometric Wall Designer](https://paulochang.com/paint/index.md): Generates wall patterns you can paint with masking tape: straight lines only, at most three colors. Live page: https://paulochang.com/paint/
- [Traffic](https://paulochang.com/traffic/index.md): The 40 classic Rush Hour-style sliding-block puzzles, with a move counter and a timer. Installs as an app and works offline. Live page: https://paulochang.com/traffic/
- [CCAR-F Study Guide](https://paulochang.com/study-guide/index.md): Offline study guide for the Claude Certified Architect (Foundations) exam: 25 markdown documents compiled into one HTML file with no dependencies. Live page: https://paulochang.com/study-guide/
- [Agent Harness Tracker](https://paulochang.com/harness/index.md): Compares AI coding agents on what a shared team harness needs: instruction files such as AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, skills, agent profiles, hooks, policy and sandboxing, MCP, code intelligence and plugin packaging. The Markdown has the full matrix, notes on each tool and the changelog. Raw data: https://paulochang.com/harness/data.json

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://paulochang.com/sitemap.xml): All indexable URLs with last-modified dates.
